answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 32649 Country: India Title: In Quran is there any where mentioned about shabe baraat ? Question: One of my freind asked me aquestion . in quran is there any where mentioned about shabe baraat ? and any where in saheeh hadees? so please guide and give the right answer. Answer ID: 32649 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1070/651/L=1432) Some commentators of the holy Quran say that Shab-e-Bara’at (fifteenth night of Sha'ban) is mentioned in the holy Quran in the verse of Surah al-Dukhan: انا انزلنه فى ليلة مباركة. Here according to some commentators, the words ليلة مباركة imply for Shab-e-Bara’at while some say that it means Shab-e-Qadr (the night of Qadr, which is mostly in Ramadan). It is mentioned in Tafseer al-Ruh al-Ma'ani: انا انزلناه فى ليلة مباركة هى ليلة القدر على ما روى عن ابن عباس وقتادة وابن جبير ومجاهد وابن زيد والحسن وعليه اكثر المفسرين والظواهر معهم ، وقال عكرمة وجماعة : هى ليلة النصف من شعبان وتسمى ليلة الرحمة والليلة المباركة ، وليلة الصك وليلة البرأة (13/110 سوره دخان). It has also been mentioned in Hadith books like Ibn Majah and al-Targhib O al-Tarhib etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
